overview.title: Built for Rust on Windows PC
paragraphs: Rust Hacks ships six menu groups—Visual ESP (two panels), Weapon Options, Aimbot Options, Misc Options, and Config Options—for wipe and monument play. Updates ship while your key is active, with Discord help for setup.
Always check availability on rust-hacks.com before you launch, especially after an EasyAnti-Cheat (EAC) or client patch.

body.text: Visual ESP Features, Visual ESP Features 2, Weapon Options, Aimbot Options, Misc Options, and Config Options. The full list with a short note on each toggle is in the feature section on this page.
Monthly $35 USD or lifetime $150 USD. Instant digital delivery worldwide after checkout.

cheats.goodToKnow: Rust and EasyAnti-Cheat (EAC) update often. Confirm availability on rust-hacks.com before you launch. Overlay behavior may differ in menus or spectator views after patches.
cheats.limitations: Third-party software can violate game terms and lead to bans. You use this software at your own risk. Compatibility can change after game, ACE, or Windows updates without notice.

overview.title: HWID recovery workflow
paragraphs: HWID Spoofer focuses on hardware profile rotation when you need a clean machine context before relaunching Rust after a hardware flag.
Monthly and lifetime USD plans use the same checkout flow as the rest of the lineup.

body.text: Use when fresh accounts fail on one PC but work elsewhere—not for account-only bans. Pair with conservative cheat presets after verification.

spoofer.goodToKnow: HWID tools change how your PC fingerprint appears—they do not remove account bans by themselves. Follow portal guides before launching Rust again.
spoofer.limitations: Spoofing carries technical risk and may violate game terms. Results vary by ban type and driver setup. Use only on systems you own.
requirements: Create a restore point before running hardware tools.
Stable internet for activation and verification steps.
